x: Poly had three internationals in Campbell, Frith and Cheskin - LAC had Winbolt-Lewis and Marsh - and running in "claret and gold" were John Mitchell and Chris Martin.

Tony Brooks ran an extremely powerful 400m to qualify for the final amongst athletes like Campbell(Poly), Shurmer(B'hth) and Jackson(W.Gn) and his 6th place in this event made him one of the favourites for the Surrey Junior title the following week.

Ernie Earl that old battler for Hercules was in great form and took his club into the lead once more and following him was a fight between Coventry, Poly and Manchester which resulted in Poly taking 2nd place through an excellent run by Campbell.
